dossier_meta.statement_text: It may be that all ternary graphs are 3-colourable.
dossier_meta.context_text: Bonamy, Charbit and Thomassé proved that every ternary graph is $c$-colourable for some absolute constant $c$, and a stronger result by two of the present authors shows bounded chromatic number whenever clique number is bounded and no induced cycle has length $p\bmod q$. The paper notes that whether the bound can be taken to be 3 for ternary graphs specifically remains open.
